description: Object with `[Symbol.asyncIterator]()` whose `next()` returns a promise of `{ value, done }`. Consumed with `for await...of`.
`async function*`: can `await` and `yield`. Pauses at each `yield` until the consumer asks for the next value.
Work happens only when a value is requested. Creating a generator runs nothing; stopping early stops the work.
Delegates to another iterable: `yield* page.items` yields each element of the array.
Each page returns an opaque cursor for the next one; `null` marks the end. Stable under inserts, unlike offsets.
`break` in `for await` calls the iterator's `return()`, so the generator's `finally` blocks run and resources are released.
